verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes substantial programmatic surfaces — Python scripting for editor automation, C++ APIs, Remote Control REST/WebSocket API for calling Blueprint-callable functions, command-line automation, and Unreal Automation Tool — covering much of what can be done in the UI. However, this is a patchwork of separate systems rather than a single unified API achieving full UI parity: Remote Control only exposes BlueprintCallable functions and preset-registered properties, Python scripting doesn't cover all editor UI workflows (e.g., some asset/level design tools, complex UI-only dialogs), and community feedback notes limitations (e.g., Blueprint/C++ gaps for certain tasks). missing for 10: evidence of complete UI-to-API parity, independent confirmation that all editor UI actions are scriptable via Python/Remote Control, and any first-party statement of comprehensive API coverage matching the UI.
